title: Blockexchange
description: Blockexchange server: http, jobs, content and the Edit Online (wasm) client. Works with several instances behind one job.

panels.title: Routes
panels.description: Over the selected time range

targets.expr: sum by (method, route) (rate(bx_http_requests_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", status=~"5.."}[$__range])) / sum by (method, route) (rate(bx_http_requests_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, method, route) (rate(bx_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])))
topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, method, route) (rate(bx_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.title: Job status
panels.description: Jobs run on one instance at a time (cluster lock): last success is the max over the instances, runs are summed. Expected intervals: update-stats 30m, schema-cleanup 5m, update-screenshots 5m, luanti-media-sync 1h. Only instances with EXECUTE_JOBS=true run the cleanup, screenshot and media jobs.

panels.description: Failed attempts to acquire the postgres job lock

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: Per instance: every instance has its own disk cache unless WASM_PACK_CACHE_DIR is shared

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(bx_wasm_pack_requests_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", result="hit"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (instance) (rate(bx_wasm_pack_requests_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", result=~"hit|miss|shared"}[$__rate_interval]))
